literary_activities:
I worked as senior Interventional Cardiologist for 35 years and as Professor for 27 years and out of which, as Director for 18 years at “Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences and Research” Bengaluru, an autonomous institution of Government of Karnataka, has brought in revolutionary changes in affordable and quality health care services. Coined and literally implemented three slogans, viz., (1) Treatment first, payment next, (2) Life is more important than file, and (3) Humanity is priority.
During my tenure as Director, the Institute recorded 500% growth with bed strength increased from 300 to 2000making it as the biggest cardiac centre in the country. Performs India’s highest number of Angioplasty and stent procedures and also trained highest number of Cardiologists (25 DM Cardiology seats). I have developed a technique in Ballon Mitral Valvuloplasty called Manjunath technique with Accura Balloon which has reduced the cost of the procedure by 40% which is a boon to poor patients of India and other third world countries have put India on the world map and trained cardiologists from USA, France, Italy, Egypt, England, Middle East on these procedures, left atrial thrombus classification is called Manjunath Classification.
other_information:
Has performed 200 Angioplasty and Stent procedure for poor patients free of cost in just 5 days which is a record by itself. 
Has shown the country that Government hospitals can also function like a five-star Corporate Hospitals for common man.
Has donated two acres of land in native village to construct Primary Health Centre which is functioning. 
To better efficiency and to prevent brain drain incentive scheme was introduced to faculty and other employees based on performance, productivity and punctuality since 
 2007, first time in Government Institutions in India.
Instrumental in introducing hub and spoke model for initial treatment of heart attack in Golden hours at Taluks hospitals in the state of Karnataka. 
Has mobilized donations from Philanthropic and charitable organisations for poor patients Corpus Fund is established. 
Former US President Barrak Obama has applauded our model of high quality affordable and flexible health care services in public sector. 
Indian Institute of Management, Bengaluru, Leadership School of Singapore, London School of Economics, Yale University of USA have appreciated my cost effective and affordable health care model.
